2k3elkoanarch.author: Gerald Claycomb III
2k3elkoanarch.description:
Well, the cards were chosen out of neccessity, since I do not have the
extensive card collections SOME people have *Glares at Brian*. The
basic strategy was to intercept as many actions from my prey as I
could, then bleed the snot out of them when he is tapped out,
preferably using someone with Pulse of the Canaille on them. Should
my prey still have blockers when it happens to be my turn, that is
were the Strike: Combat Ends combat cards help out, as well as when
everybody decides I need to leave the table, and start salmon swimming
towards me. If I had the cards that I would have prefered in the
deck, I would have swapped out the Putreficatioins for Majesties, but
I only had 4 of them, and Putrefications did work (I guess no one uses
them for the Presence ability but me). I would have also added Eagle's
Sight, to intercept annoying votes that wasn't called by my Pred/Prey.

I had alot of luck during the Tournament, being able to get Jost in
the 1st four on three of the four matches, so he happened to be my big
bad bleeder, as well as having a combat deck as my predator the
majority of times, which helped me out since I was able to draw my
S:CE cards as they drew Rushes and the like. All in all, I really do
not have many complaints about my own deck, since it did work
according to my plans. I guess I could complain about the fact that
the crypt capacity average was higher than I wished it to be, but
looking at the Elder Library database, there wasn't many I wished to
add. Sometimes the deck wasn't cycling cards fast enough, but that is
something that could have been remedied at the time.
2k3elkoanarch.name: Bleeding Fags

2k3originsfriday.author: Matt Flint
2k3originsfriday.description: Description: Bleed + Stealth + Form of Mist (if necessary). Repeat.
2k3originsfriday.name: Gangrel Bleed Monkeys

2k3originsthursday.author: Carol O'Bryan
2k3originsthursday.description:
This is basically an all-around sneak & bleed but bash 'em if they block you
deck. On the first round, I worked all the way through my cards two turns
before the end of the game, so it's a good thing I decided to throw in enough
cards to bring the deck to 90. The final saw me entombing the majority of my
predator's vamps and sneaking through the defenses of my prey to eventually
pump a bleed and take him out. One thing I'd do to make it more effective
would be to put in another Tension or two, and to figure out some way to handle
the Immortal Grapple decks a wee bit better.
2k3originsthursday.name: Fairies 'R Us

2k3swallowedco.author: Nick Smith
2k3swallowedco.description:
"Gentleness"

The deck is called "Gentleness" based on my Jyhad philosophy that
goes, "The gentle Methuselah is the successful Methuselah". The deck
is "gentle" because it comes out slowly and lets the game develop
around it. Much like Jay plays most of the time. Combat is based
around Silvia blowing beads off of less-combat capable vampires. Zack
and Chester are backups who provide crypt-draw variety. It "cheats"
in terms of combat in that it uses Skin of Steel for protection only
in the basic. This is bad for two reasons. One, I normally am weak
against Celerity combat. Two, I can't use SoS when Silvia or others
are empty. Hence, the Giant's Blood and Tastes.
2k3swallowedco.name: Unknown

2k3charlottejune.author: David Cherryholmes
2k3charlottejune.description:
Timing is key for this deck. Park the Week under a Storage Annex until
the time is right. Bleed lightly but consistently during the early and
midgame. I tend to play recklessly and get out the fourth minion the turn
before I plan to pop the Week. By then, you ought to have a few +1 bleed
toys in play, and I have reliably hit one-turn bleeds of 12-16. Gabrin's
"other white meat" special, Nightmare Curses, and Red Herrings are very
useful for getting your prey's minions all tapped out just prior to the
wave of death. There's no hit back to the deck, but most people expect it
from the Ravnos, so work this early game on tables that don't know your
deck. You do have thirteen cards of "you can't touch this", though, so
don't be too afraid of blocking or being rushed (Grapple is, of course, a
bitch).

David Cherryholmes
VEKN Prince of Durham, NC
david.cherryholmes@duke.edu
2k3charlottejune.name: So Long, and Thanks For all the Fish

2k3sdgothenburg.description:
Description: Obfuscate bleeder based on Spying Mission with some
bleed and combatdefence.
A rather hefty bloatenginge for this type of deck.
Play this and get rushed. A bleeder is a bleeder even if it looks
a bit different from the standard ones, and as such it is really
awfully boring to play. Tap out with everything unless a Deflection
isn't paired with a wake.
2k3sdgothenburg.name: Spying Mission

2k3ecrq.description:
Description: Daughter of Cacophony Deck
2003 Mid-Atlantic Regional Qualifier winning deck
2k3ecrq.name: Lost Girls Just Wanna Have Fun

2k3watfordmay.author: Rob Treasure
2k3watfordmay.description:
Description: Ummmm... Pretty obvious bleed or rush with lots of Pot
minions. Use Computer Hacks to force blocks or bleed for steady twos.
Bring back diab'ed minions with Hand of Conrad. Use Tributes as soon
as you get them, don't be afraid to Tribute to empty cos most of
minions can use Hungry Coyote when you get it to fill back up. Change
of Targets draw out wakes etc and make the deck a tiny bit faster and
much more annoying by adding to the total number of actions possible.
Ivory Bow is in mainly to contest because its about the most common
'worst single thing' you can come across and is pretty useful on its
own. Two non-pot Sabbat weenies are there to make up numbers, would do
without and go down to twelve but have run out of crypt a few times
which is no fun.

Also was a bit of an experiment on a few different levels. Has put my
mind to rest that a weenie pot Sabbat Embrace is indeed missed deck
opportunity #23 **sigh**

Wanted to try a version with a lot of solid masters and it worked
pretty well - what you lose in cycling you more than make up for in
pool gain so that works for me. A lot of the masters (18 assuming a
minion is out) are playable 'out of the box' so you don't often have
them sat in your hand... Which is nice.

A goodly amount of pool gen for a Pot deck and two AI's coupled with
numbers backrushTM makes for a pretty resilient Pot horde that keeps
on coming.

Anyway enough crap here is 'Brick in a sock'
2k3watfordmay.name: Brick in a sock

2k3edmontonqualifier.author: Kevin J. Wiebe
2k3edmontonqualifier.description:
Description: This Anarch Revolt deck is extremely nasty and
aggressive. The key to its success is to get The Parthenon, Anson,
and Rumors of Gehenna into play as soon as possible. With them in
play, you will have 3 master phase actions and be able to quickly use
the many master cards that are in this deck. This deck will make all
players lose pool every turn. And with the many Dominate bleed cards,
along with Misdirection, Seduction, and The Sleeping Mind, you will be
able to bleed your prey and ensure that he or she is the first player
to be ousted.
2k3edmontonqualifier.name: Anarch Revolt (Mixed Clans)

2k3dallasmay.author: Ethan Burrow
2k3dallasmay.description:
Orgy of Flesh - Breathe Harder Remix
Description: This deck is a modification to the Orgy of Flesh Palla
Grande/Vic deck. This adds the combat module used in Bow Down Before
Matteus, specifically the Breath of the Dragon and Rötschreck. Ideally
you focus on creating Creation Rites vampires with vic, and then they
either bleed when the Palla Grande is out, or Art Scam when it's not.
Non vic vampires do maintenence actions or get bleed defense duty.
Newly created Creation Rites can use Breath/Rötschreck to deter pesky
actions against you. Always influence out a titled vampire first, as
without the additional minions this deck might stall. With a titled
vampire out, the deck starts to roll almost immediately if the
Creation Rites are not blocked.
2k3dallasmay.name: Unknown

2k3warpartycsc.author: Jeffrey Thompson
2k3warpartycsc.description:
Description: This deck won the War Party: Charleston, South Carolina
tournament on April 26th, 2003. There were 14 players, two rounds and
a final. This deck took game wins all three rounds.

The deck was designed to get out a larger Lasombra with superior
Dominate, who would then use Govern the Unaligned and Scouting Mission
to bring out the other vampires in the crypt. I always got at least
one vampire for free this way.

This deck was the Lasombra Commons deck that I won a tournament in Los
Angeles with a few years ago, but that got bumped up to 89 cards where
the original was 73 cards. There was also supposed to be a hunting
ground in the deck, but I forgot to add it in.

In the Charleston event, I took 4vp, 2.5VP, and then 3vp in the
finals.
2k3warpartycsc.name: Lasombra Governing

2k3politicalflux.author: Neil Paananen
2k3politicalflux.description:
Description: Use the PRE obf vamps to call charming lobbies with
bewitching orations and voter caps. Use the obf vamps to call the
next vote, or piggyback another charming lobby with a pre obf vamp.
Get permanent votes as quickly as possible. Generally don't bother
blocking, as you shouldl be gaining a lot during your turn.

The Protected Resources should help a lot, however I found I often
had to burn them to get the edge or to bleed because I didn't have
votes or my votes wouldn't have passed. So obviously the deck needs
some work, particularly with the new voting system of the Anarch set.
2k3politicalflux.name: Lies and Obfuscations (aka Your Government)

2k3bratislavablessing.author: Tibor Morocz
2k3bratislavablessing.description:
Description: Blessing of Chaos 2003: Bratislava - Winning Deck.
Ventrue with Politics, Bleed, Deflections and Majesty. Hard to Catch,
Hard to Kill.
2k3bratislavablessing.name: Law Enforcement

2k3tcithaca.author: Peter Bakija
2k3tcithaca.description: "But Where are Kim and Kelly Deal?"
2k3tcithaca.name: Unknown

2k3swedenqual.author: Erik Torstensson
2k3swedenqual.description:
A warm saturday morning saw 24 players gathering for the swedish
ECQ.
Judge Sten Düring
2k3swedenqual.name: Unknown

2k3cchqssiphilippines.author: Danz Holandez
2k3cchqssiphilippines.name: For Those About to Die, We Salubri

2k3bath1.author: Hugh Angseesing
2k3bath1.description:
"Camille & Raven's Royal Bash"

This deck is based upon a deck I used to play before NRA rules were
introduced. When DS was first released Force of Will added to Freak
Drive, Day Operation, Movement of the Slow Body & a Rapid Healing or
two, was just insane. To compensate for the "limited" number of bleed
actions being performed, some of the Rapid Healing/Force of Wills
have been replaced by Dominate cards.
2k3bath1.name: Unknown

2k3burningtouch.author: Brian Wellington
2k3burningtouch.description:
Description: I'm still surprised that this worked.
[In my words, a bunch of cool cards tossed together.]

(*) There should have only been 3 of these, but I accidentally added
extras.
2k3burningtouch.name: Unnamed Salubri Deck #1

2k3greensboro.author: David Cherryholmes
2k3greensboro.description:
I posted the deck to the group when I was first putting it
together. Here's the actual tweak I played at the tournament. I've
renamed the deck in my head as "Twenty Around the Table", but it just
makes people antsy somehow.
2k3greensboro.name: She's a Cross-Eyed Beast

2k3endicot.author: Albert Chang
2k3endicot.description:
Description: Tremere seduction/bonding bleed with only theft and
movements to regain blood on vampires. Only Jyhad cards used, except
in the crypt, which is a 1/2 crypt. Perhaps a tad monotonous, but it
seems to work okay.
2k3endicot.name: Second Round? What Second Round?

2k3greatlakes.author: David Wilson
2k3greatlakes.description:
Description: Anyone who says Garou are not worth 5 pool haven't seen
this deck. This deck has played in tournaments all over North
America, its earliest viable version can be found on Seattle's
Qualifier page for 2002. A constant work in progress that began to
show people that memories was broken, but it isn't as I have proven
to myself. Drop the suddens, put in DI, add more delaying, Ancilla
Empowerment can do 15 damage to you no problem in this deck so
BEWARE!! Good luck, if you play the deck or want advice on how to,
let me know, it isn't as easy as it looks, you can kill yourself very
very quickly. Great Lakes Qualifier was 45 people. doros@umich.edu
btw brothers grimm made this deck flow...
2k3greatlakes.name: Garou by Night

2k3masterofpuppets.author: Marcus Mock
2k3masterofpuppets.description: Tzimisce Intercept with a hint of Warghoul
2k3masterofpuppets.name: Unknown

2k3watfordmarch.author: Jon Cooper
2k3watfordmarch.description:
Description: Call up the Great Beast, give him VICISSITUDE TEMPORIS and
OBEAH and let the good times roll. Ideal opening hand is Minion tap,
Vicissitude skill card a call the great beast and lost in crowds/Domain
of Evernight. Bring out Huitzopochtli use his special to gain another
master phase so you can Minion Tap and put a skill card on him and hope
theres not massive intercept around...

... this was an evolution of the mid 70 card version i included in the
Great Beast *ahem* newsletter but found that i kept running out of
cards. Boosted the defence and bloat side of the deck and it seemed to
flow well in the 2nd and 3rd rounds, only stuttering in the final and
the first round (when bleeding James and his Mobile Intercept
Vehicle...:)
Still managed 3GW11 in total on the day, so not tooooo shabby for
a Baali deck...(chortle)
2k3watfordmarch.name: Call 666 B-E-A-S-T

2k3tensionranks.author: Tom Mickle
2k3tensionranks.description: Jake & fake, Pool & ghoul, Bounce & trounce
2k3tensionranks.name: Unknown

2k3scregion.author: Devin Villegas
2k3scregion.description:
Description: Inspiration for the deck comes from Oscar Garza. We figured
out the card list for this deck on paper before I touched a single card.
Pretty much just bloat with the kindred spirits. Let your prey work
themselves into striking distance, drop a madman's quill and explode.
2k3scregion.name: Crazy Weenie Bloat

2k3castrovalleyfeb.author: Ian Lee
2k3castrovalleyfeb.description:
Deck Design: Colin Riggs, tweaked & played by Ian Lee
Description: Use weenies to Honor the Elders many times, swarm bleed with Elders.
The combat cards need to be tweaked some more.
2k3castrovalleyfeb.name: Silent Sympathy

2k3thawing.author: Erik Torstensson
2k3thawing.description:
Description: someone has stolen rachel's sneakers (or something).
Probably your prey. She wants it back. By killing. Bleed, oust, win.
Victoria is "great" with the network, which is broken. Earth meld is
broken too. Add some candy just for fun like Sniper Rifle, Ivory Bow
and Aarons Feeding Razor. You don't need the Madness Network /
homonolucus combo to win, though it make things more easy. Cards that
also would fit in are probably gigants blood and Curse of Nitocris.
Muddled vampire hunter is great to make players leave the network
alone, one more would be good. The only problem for this deck is
Immortal Grapple, but no one ever plays it around here so... in an
more grappling environment I would add Claws of the Dead and
Rötschreck. Or some more Sniper Rifles.
2k3thawing.name: Die Kuchenfrau goes mad

2k3praxisurbana.author: Eric Chiang
2k3praxisurbana.description:
Description: A !Tremere vote deck that
utilizes Presence. Alfred, Ayelea, and Bryan already
have Presence. Ian can play Presence cards. Otherwise,
use a combination of Infernal Pact, Presence skill
cards, and Created Gargoyles (cute Pokemon proxies).
Once you manage to secure political domination,
outplay, outwit, and outlast your opponents!

* Story-line Legal


[Misc.: 6 cards

Clan Toys: 3 cards


Discipline: 41 cards]
[7 Auspex, 8 Dominate, 20 Presence, 6 Thaumaturgy
2k3praxisurbana.name: The !Tremere Make Their Presence Known

2k3zaragoza.author: Tomeu Mádico
2k3zaragoza.description:
Description: Put in play a gargoyle and a tremere. Put in play as many cats
as posible, and use all those slave tricks and vis/tha cards. Most of the
time, via charisma and soul of the earth, the rock cats hit the table for
free. Armor of terra-daring the dawn also grants a fair posibility to put
them in play.
2k3zaragoza.name: Kitties

2k3rome.author: Marco La Valle
2k3rome.description:
"Mr. Majestic"

A horde of small cap vampires with PRE relentlessly bleed and vote,
taking multiple actions in the same turn. Charming lobby, awe and
bewitching orations provide huge amount of votes, and voter
captivations replenish your vampires, so allowing unlimited use of
superior Majesty. Expect everybody at the table to turn against you:
which is good, since you will cycle even faster through your library!
This deck will be completely shut down by Atonement, so use your
Hostile Takeover judiciously (a second one will be necessary, when
this list will be made public).
2k3rome.name: Unknown

2k3nycmarch.author: Peter Vabulas
2k3nycmarch.description:
Description: nossie princes bring out 3rd trad weenies
bleed with computer hacks, stealth, night moves
bloat with tributes and con boon
2k3nycmarch.name: Nosferatu

2k3andreasfeb.author: Andreas Nusser
2k3andreasfeb.description: Description: A little bit of toolboxing
2k3andreasfeb.name: Tremere Second Tradition Deck

2k3totalconben.author: Ben Swainbank
2k3totalconben.description:
Lazverinus is the star of the show. His job is to take out opposing
minions using multi-rush/Freak Drive to do multiple actions per turn
for lots of damage and rapid card cycling. This clears the way for the
support team to bleed my prey.

With Laz's +2 Strength I can have a combat deck with very few
do-damage cards (only 7) and focus more on picking fights, surviving
them, and beating combat defense. Lazverinus isn't stopped by
Obedience and Grapple-punch for 3-press-punch for 3 again takes most
minions down.

The deck had great flow and played very well on Sat.

Another things I like about this deck is that I finally found a way to
get Political Ally to work.
2k3totalconben.name: Laz-Man Standing

2k3totalconRobyn.author: Robyn Tatu
2k3totalconRobyn.description:
Description: Group 2 / 3 Cryptic Mission.
Designed to take out deflectors because I was sick of being ousted by them.
Who knew?
2k3totalconRobyn.name: Cryptic Mission

2k3baltipurge.author: Dan Keller
2k3baltipurge.description:
Dan Keller of Washington, DC was declared the winner with 1.5 victory
points in the Finals of the Baltimore Purge VTES Tournament February 8,
2003. The game went to time after 16-turns. Survivors of the final
(in order) with 0.5VP each, were: Jason Babbit of Manassas, VA; Greg
Williams of Elkton, MD; and Blake Stewart of Hanover, MD. Josh Duffin
of Bethesda, MD made an early exit (ouch!) in the finals after
finishing the preliminaries with the highest ranking.

The tournament was held at Games and Comics and Stuff in Beautiful
Downtown Glen Burnie, MD. Fifteen Methuselahs came from Virginia,
Maryland, Pennsylvania, and Washington, D.C. to play and grab a copy of
the Wind Dance promo card.

Description: Nosferatu Anti-Gun Combat/Toolbox

Comments: I created this deck in response to the growing regularity of
guns in our local (Washington, DC) play environment. The Thrown Gates
were a recent addition to the deck, and I found during the course of
play that the DOtBs were pretty much useless when I could strike at
long range. So I will probably dump the DOtB's. Patagia will probably
go too.

The full discription of the final and Glen Burnie event may be found at
2k3baltipurge.name: Guns Don't Kill People, Vampires Do

2k3forceofwillh.author: Oscar Garza
2k3forceofwillh.description:
Description: oh yeah, i built that deck about 20 minutes before the
tournament started, standing at the back of my car in the rain.
2k3forceofwillh.name: Tzimisce Vote

2k3psmilwaukee.author: Cameron Domer
2k3psmilwaukee.description:
MOTTO: Coming soon to a school board near you.

Notes:

DO NOT SCARE THE TABLE... if at all convenient.

Get out Arika... burn people for fun and profit.
Profit is Minion Tap/Voter Cap. Use the Governs
to bring out friends for Arika. Relies on Zillah's
to outrun Combat Decks to a vampire, who can then be
burned with PTO, and fails utterly to weenie combat,
fast big combat, Camarilla combat, and any of the same
if it's bleed.

This deck came into being preNERFing of 5th Tradition.
I put it together to see if I could still get big
vamp bloat to work. I managed to guess the local
metagame to a T on the sect issues required to play
the deck. Only one deck I saw was all Camarilla.

Changes: Some GtU to Mind Rape, 3 Lucinde 2 Vitel
lots more combat D/bleed D depending on metagame.
I've added all the Awe's I own, more may be good.

Cameron Domer
orcaorcinus@hotmail.com
2k3psmilwaukee.name: Unknown

2k3winddanceboston.author: Ben Peal
2k3winddanceboston.description:
Second Guess Corral

It's hardly the most original deck - it's based on Colin Riggs'
winning deck from a recent DC tournament. I just didn't like
the fact that its only defensive option is to go upstream, so
I dropped a few Bum's Rushes and the Computer Hackings and
Arsons, and put in some wakes, bleed bounce/reduction, and light
intercept. It didn't run very consistently, and I think 9 or 10
guns and 9 or 10 Concealed Weapons may be the way to go, as I
had some difficulty getting a gun early on in a couple games.
Some of the consistency problems were likely the result of the
increased number of fight decks and reduced number of bleed decks,
reducing the effectiveness of the defense. The intercept did
prove to be quite handy.

Here's Colin Riggs' deck, for comparison:


Thank to all who showed up! It was great to see the turnout!

- Ben Peal
2k3winddanceboston.name: Unknown

2k3gothenburgblizzard.author: Sten Düring
2k3gothenburgblizzard.description:
Description: Camarilla Edition version of an older tournament winner
based on Toreadors with Obfuscate.

Disguise out big guns, block and torporize while tasting back blood
for later bloat. The deck is very expensive to play so Parity Shift
with a couple of token stealth-cards is there to help you get back in
business. There's just enough rush to keep players wary of you, but
count on having to spend at least three turns doing nothing while
bloating.
2k3gothenburgblizzard.name: CE Firepower

2k3strangercolumbus.author: John Bell
2k3strangercolumbus.description:
Description: Switched out a bit of the combat and some of the
reactions for more Computer Hackings. It gave the deck more teeth as
far as pool reduction, however there were too many combats where I had
to exchange "hands for 1" with my opponent.

John Bell
Prince of Cincinnati
2k3strangercolumbus.name: Break Stuff - 1st place Columbus, OH 1-11-03

2k2gothenburgLAST.author: Simon Carlsson
2k2gothenburgLAST.description:
Description: A simple to use bleed deck, usually bleeds for 2 or 3 and
bloats with Kindred spirits and Blood of the sabbat. The key to
winning is Secure haven. With only one active protected vampire, the
combat decks have to fight someone else.
2k2gothenburgLAST.name: Malk antitribu slowbleeder

2k2jaypitts.author: Jay Kristoff
2k2jaypitts.description:
On 12/14/2002 Ira Fay hosted Crusade: Pittsburgh. Ten methusulaths
participated (Twice the number of participants in Ira's June 2001
tournament). Most of the players were locals, with travelers John
and Tom Mickle (from central PA), and myself (Jay from Columbus OH).
After two rounds and a final, my weenie Auspex deck came out on top.
If anyone who was there wants to recap some of the events of the day;
please do. For now I'll just post the deck.

Jay's weenie Auspex

This deck is based on Jason Dawson's (of Seattle) weenie Auspex deck.
It has been Jay-ified, however. This deck won a four player tournament
in Lansing MI in late October of 2002. I waited to post it until it won
at a larger (10 player) event:) The Sniper Rifles are great against close
combat. I oust people with a hoard of one bleeds or with Fame/Sniper Riffle.
I can afford Club Zombie because my vamps are cheap, and because it's hard
to oust me with all of the reaction cards and blockers.

PS: The day after the tournament my girlfriend and I flew from Pittsburgh to
New Orleans for vacation. Six days later Trent Rezner (of Nine Inch Nails)
was on our flight back to Pittsburgh. I wanted to give him a copy of Majesty
with the Nine Inch Nails quote on it. Unfortunately all I had on me were Cam.
edition Majesties (from the cool prize support from the Pittsburgh tourney)
with the bible quote. So, no Majesty for Trent.
2k2jaypitts.name: Unknown

2k2australiachamp.author: Craig Johnston
2k2australiachamp.description:
Description: What can I say? It's a Malkavian/!Malkavian
Stealth Bleed deck, utilising (in my opinion) the best vampires from
each Clan in terms of bleed potential, without being too large in
it's Crypt capacity. It's not terribly harsh in it's bleed capacity,
only bleeding for 4 at most without any static bleed modifiers. It
also has quite a large capacity for blood gain (although not
excessivly so). Not as much defence as I would normally like in a
bleed deck (which tend to come under combat fire regularly) but the
Lunatics are not known for their combat evasion.
2k2australiachamp.name: The Best of Both Worlds

2k2lastaustralia.author: Anthony Barker
2k2lastaustralia.description:
Description: Lasombra bleed with some combat and votes. Some blood gain to fill
up the big bleeder. Festivo dello Estinto and Disarm weren't very helpful.
DI was a lifesaver.
2k2lastaustralia.event: Australian NC 2002 Day 1 - Last Chance Qualifier
2k2lastaustralia.name: Gratiano's Egg Basket

2k2artisticallydc.author: Trey Morita
2k2artisticallydc.description:
Description: Get Nikolaus. Use his special plus 4th
Tradition to bring out more Nossies. Most people won't
bother blocking a few bleeds for 1 per turn, and
combine that with a KRC or Parity Shift every turn or
so for ousting power. Decent combat, but no grapples.
2k2artisticallydc.name: Nikolas's Crew

2k2newarkbloodfeast.author: John Bell
2k2newarkbloodfeast.description:
Notes:
Only pool gain in for this deck is 6 going forward; going backward is
only a survival option to buy time to oust your prey.
2k2newarkbloodfeast.name: Break Stuff

2k2slovakben.author: Ben Peal
2k2slovakben.description:
I had a Gargoyles deck in development that had won 4 of 4 casual games,
including one where I lent it to someone, so I figured it was ready for
prime time. It consists of weenie Tremere 12, with Tremere Slaves
operating like the offensive line of an American football team, clearing
the way for the Tremere. As such, I've called it The O-Line.:)
The Tremere are just there for weenie bleeds, with the occasional
Conditioning or J.S. Simmons/Tasha Morgan, as well as Deflections.
The Gargoyles are Pot/For/Flight monsters, and they also handle the
bulk of the defense, with Razor Bats (which have proved surprisingly
handy) and Defenders of the Haven.

The O-Line by Ben Peal
2k2slovakben.name: Unknown

2k2eclastq.author: Stéphane Lavrut
2k2eclastq.description: Description: Here is THE wargoule deck
2k2eclastq.name: Unknown

2k2umbrage.author: Sten Düring
2k2umbrage.description:
Description: Getting as many master-phase-actions as possible. Empty
your vamps and don't be shy to use Rosslers speacial and Information
Highway together. Tap Anson, Golconda Anson (using his special to do so)
and bring a new Anson in play. The Baali can help with additional
master-phase actions.

Try avoiding trickling out your revolts as you'll need two or three in
one go to finish the game.

Golconda is also an offensive card. You're the only one who need large
vampires - the rest of the table can use the pool, especially your predator.

You win with the revolts and you need the massive bloat to make your
Life Boons count.

Even though it will eat on your nerves, to chose when to play without
any vampires at all is definitely what changes a loss to a win. On
average I'll sit close to a third of any given game without any
controlled minions.

Votes are a problem, as is any weenie-predator.

68 Mastercards is a bit low, and I think one each of Obedience,
Wake and Deflection could go. I'd also remove Legendary Vampire.
Replace with three Archon Investigation and one Tension in the
Ranks. Maybe also replace one Information Highway and one The
Barrens with two Dreams of the Sphinx.
2k2umbrage.name: Master Madness

2k2nephandusmage.author: Scott Gomes
2k2nephandusmage.description:
Was supposed to be a bruise and bleed but worked better as a
opportunity power stealth bleed with casual intercept combat.
Reason being is that at almost every table I sat at had more
intimidating combat such as, Grant's Animalism combat deck
and Ulysses' Assamite deck.
2k2nephandusmage.name: When Keebler Elves go bad.

2k2shadowslengthen.author: Sten Düring
2k2shadowslengthen.description:
Description: Combining Aching Beauty and Toreador Grand Ball may look
like a strange strategy. Add in Mask of a thousand Faces and it makes
more sense.
Declare non-bleed actions with your unblockable vampire. Play Mask and
finish the action in order to get another unblockable action.
Try playing bleed-modifiers and Aching Beauty/Camarilla Exemplary on
different vampires. Declare bleeds for lots. If blocked, Mask in some
pool-punishment. If bounced, Mask in a lower amount of bleed.
Expensive mastercards go hand in hand with Parity Shift.

Doing this deck again I'd throw out all equipment and add another three
Majesty.
2k2shadowslengthen.name: Masking the Unblockable

2k2crusadelondon.author: Martin Cubberly
2k2crusadelondon.description:
Description: Shoot things. A lot.

Having now played it, I reckon a few things should probably change.
Didn't see any use for the IR Goggles or the Waste Management (the
latter presumably because all the games were so quick, no one got near
the bottom of their library) but I did realise I didn't have enough
Rush. Often I was stuck with no way of getting into combat...
The intercept always came in handy, but without Wakes it meant it
effectively cost me a minion... Wonder if it could stand to loose
these as well...

God Bless the new Concealed Weapon though. What a beauty...
2k2crusadelondon.name: Gunslinging Varmints

2k2cooperjack.author: Jon Cooper
2k2cooperjack.description:
Description: Let the anarchy spread...

Completely untested (prior to the tournament), i would remove the
cats guidance and probably change the temptations to two more forms
of corruption. They were great with jack hitting your preys vampires
blood and then burning it when they were down to zero. An
interesting strategy, to just sit there, build up and then whack
jack on the table and just defend. Slightly random IE. Someone across
the table usually bought it from jacks effect, and is definitely
better to wait until your down a player as defending it against 4
other meths is NO FUN(tm).
2k2cooperjack.name: Jacks Back Part 1

2k2crusadeelko.author: Misty Martin
2k2crusadeelko.description: Description: Basic Malkavian preconstructed deck with a few tweaks.
2k2crusadeelko.name: Misty's Malkavians

2k2dragonconbd.author: Derek S. Ray
2k2dragonconbd.description:
No real play notes -- this is a relatively stock Giovanni powerbleed.
The AVA was very convenient as nobody ever bothered to take the action to burn
it -- I'd have rather had a second one in the deck than the Mausoleum, which
got discarded a lot. Same with the Venetian Conference, as I was able to play
at least one to good effect in each round, including the final (to torporize a
hunting Suhailah). Many people are familiar with the +1 intercept from superior
Spectral Divination and will plan around it, so being able to have the +2 intercept
coming from Francesca was excellent. (This also let me save the Spectral Divination
for extra stealth.)

Description: Giovanni Seductive Telemarketer filth, tweaked up for an expected
Camarilla-heavy tournament with Venetian Conferences and Gillespi -- also shifted
around to be more Deflection-proof with no Conditionings and mostly
Scouting Mission/Bondings.
2k2dragonconbd.name: Yer Mom Don't Block

2k2sydney0.author: Chris Arthur
2k2sydney0.description:
Some bleed, some bloat and plenty of stealth. If things are going well
summon Qufur or Samat and Rutor them. If not, summon Hesha, load up
with Blood Dolls, the razor and a secure haven and survive until
things get better. Amam and Jake are great to throw in front of rush
combat. Plus it's ok if a few vamps go to torpor because you can
bring them out easily with humanitas and catacombs. Nice if you can
get either on a secured vamp early. Bloat is pretty much the only
defence against votes and bleed but with a small library the deck
moves quickly and you can be gaining 3-4 pool a turn before other
players become threatening.
2k2sydney0.event: Days of the Dead - Qualifier for the 2002 Australian Championship
2k2sydney0.name: Rutor's Followers

2k2genconchampion.author: Jared Strait
2k2genconchampion.description:
Needs a small amount of adjustment, but in general played well for
being constructed at 1am the morning of the finals.

Jared
2k2genconchampion.name: Unknown

2k2winnipeg.author: Paul Choquette
2k2winnipeg.description:
Description: I built this deck the night before, and it was completely untested.
There are a lot of changes that I would have made to it if I did it
again, but S&B usually isn't my thing.
2k2winnipeg.name: Lasombra Uber threat 90 cards

2k2seekonkclarity.author: Matthew Hirsch
2k2seekonkclarity.description:
Dominate/Fortitude/Protean with the dual capability of bruise 'n bleed
and rush/fame. Defensive mechanisms are Deflection and upstream
rush. Lazverinus is the 'star player' but isn't essential to the
deck. Intercept is forgone in lieu of more focused rush and some
political activity.
2k2seekonkclarity.name: 15 Minutes of Fame

2k2camarillathreat.author: Trey Morita
2k2camarillathreat.description:
Gabrin's Paradox
Description: Use Sense Dep on your predator to buy you breathing room.
If you prey's actions gain him pool (votes + voter captivation, fifth
tradition) or he rushes backwards, then sense dep him too if you can.
Try to wait until someone is ousted before you play Week of Nightmares
(Store it in an Annex until then). Playing the waiting game can be
effective. Oh yeah, always get Lazar first if you draw him in your
opening crypt. If your prey is playing big vampires he will definitely
be worth it. (Once, on turn 2, I had Lazar bleed with computer hacking,
Freak Drive, and steal one from my prey's big vampire)

Would drop Red Herring, Ignis Fatuus, Rapid Healing. Maybe could use
another Draba, another Sensory Deprivation. Clan Impersonation or Golconda
would be useful/funny ways to save or sacrifice Gabrin before the last
Nightmare counter is placed. Secure Haven might be a good addition to
protect Gabrin from rushes.
2k2camarillathreat.name: Unknown

2k2canberraq.author: Chris Wall
2k2canberraq.event: Legacy of Power - Australian Championship Qualifier 2002
2k2canberraq.name: Unknown

2k2thadius.author: Lance Shope
2k2thadius.description:
Description: Obf bleed with Legal Manipulation. Majesty if you get
intercepted. Use the temptations on your own vampires if they run
low on blood. They can Legal Manipulate (cost one blood) then Tempt
self to hunt and gain the blood back. Or Tempt opponent's vampires
(standard). Deck may be master card heavy at 17. Possibly dump an
Info Highway and a Blood Doll or Giant's Blood and replace with
Swallowed By The Night, the maneuver is critical against "Grapple"

2k2origins2.author: Jay Kristoff

Well my luck continued on Friday at Origins this year. My other
Gangrel deck won that tournament. This deck is a beefed up version
of my Can I Wear This Jacket? deck that I used to win the Newark OH
storyline event www.geocities.com/vtesresults/semsith/newarkOH.htm)
I guess that the new beef comes from more combat options and more
damaging votes. Because the Gangrel are no longer in the Cam., I am
not sure how much longer I will be allowed to play decks like these.
It certainly was fun to play on Friday.

Can I Wear This Jacket Too?
by Jay Kristoff

2k2origins1.author: Jay Kristoff

I just got home from an amazing first day at Origins. I was able to

Mirembe Rides Again!

2k2weenieroast.author: Matthew Hirsch
2k2weenieroast.description:
Description: Bloat up and build a horde of low-caps
plus Anneke or Anson. Give guns to the ones with Celerity.
Swarm and destroy.

The offense isn't as fast as other tourney decks, but
once it gets rolling it has pretty strong momentum.
Small caps with guns and superior Auspex can run a
tight defense to allow time for that longer build-up.
2k2weenieroast.name: "The Gun is My Brush, Your Face is My Canvas"

2k2ukqualifier.author: Jon Cooper
2k2ukqualifier.description:
I would probably drop the strained vitae supply, a hunting ground
(maybe both), the arcane library and possibly the Info Highway.
Maybe replace with 1-2 more cryptic missions or bit more bleed.
Possibly another embrace or two? Have tried using Rastafarian ghoul
but is too pricy and too fragile.
Jon
2k2ukqualifier.name: This deck will self destruct in 4 seconds...

2k2halmicon.author: Henrik Isaksson
2k2halmicon.description: Description: Equip, rush, diablerize, freakdrive, rush, diablerize...
2k2halmicon.name: Tariq and his little brother Juan Cali goes out eating!

2k2bostonmay.author: Ben Swainbank
2k2bostonmay.description:
Deck: Monster's Ball

I've had a very good record with this deck in casual games, and now in a
tournament. Its fairly straightforward, but a good bit of R&D went into
testing and tuning it. Intercept combat. A nice layered defense of solid
intercept (with an option to KO), light bounce, and Greta, mostly keeps
you out of trouble.

The Palla Grandes, with maybe help from Fame, give you a kicker to swoop
in on your prey, and oust (maybe with Aire as the closer). The deck has
enough juice to do this twice, but kind of runs out of ousting power after
that. But, typically, its just enough to win the table.

I started thinking about this deck after having my sneaky decks shut down
by intercept monsters in a few tournaments. Kind of -- If you can't beat
them, join them. Then give them a beating.
2k2bostonmay.name: Unknown

2k2mexicocity.author: Alejandro Hernandez Molina
2k2mexicocity.description: Description: Vote Deck with a twist.
2k2mexicocity.name: CS Ventrue

2k2watfordmay.author: Tony Smith
2k2watfordmay.description:
Didn't have too many problems on the day and the combination of bone
crunching combat and 2nd tradition seemed to handle most things. A
little slow getting the first point in the final, which nearly
scuppered my plans.

The first version of this had 4 Don Cruez. I later decided that using
a smaller crypt and another Protean master was probably the way to go.
I may even drop the Dons to 2 and add a second Beast. I usually went
for either Theo or Volker first, on the basis that the Don was just
too big. Although, to be fair, his maneuver did save me a couple of
times against the Wookie's assamites.

Not much in the way of subtlety, but hey, burning vampires is fun.

Remember kids, don't do drugs.

Tony

Literary Thug
2k2watfordmay.name: You die, we win.

2k2bicvc.author: Ian Lee
2k2bicvc.description:
My decks do things besides bleed ... at stealth. They also hunt.
Um, Samedi stealth/unblockable bleed.
2k2bicvc.name: Weapon Not Found

2k2midatlantic.author: Josh Duffin
2k2midatlantic.description:
"Never smile at a crocodile"

supposed to refill for Tap/Doll with Heidelberg, though the threat of that existed more than the reality...

I've been playing a lot more 80-card decks than 90 lately; none of
my non-rush-combat decks seem to run out of cards very often at all
even at 80.

Form of Corruption is great, especially if it makes your prey
afraid to bleed too much and keeps him from ousting. It seems to
be often better to hang on to your Form until after your initial
prey is ousted and then steal one of your (former) grandprey's
vamps with it; it's a big boost on your way to (trying to) get
that second oust.

This deck is actually exactly how I designed it on paper before
ever playing it, except that I switched a Hesha Ruhadze for a
second Kephamos after writing it down (but still before playing
it). Funny because my whole goal in the two weeks before the
tournament was to come up with a decent deck and have time to
tweak it before the event, but the one I ended up wanting to
play didn't need any tweaking (at least from the couple games
I'd tried it in beforehand).

Josh

Mid-Atlantic US VTES Champion 2002
(heh)

2k2pariseq.author: Stéphane Lavrut
2k2pariseq.description:
"Voters will get your death"

2k2pariseq.name: Unknown

2k2ncrq.author: John Bell
2k2ncrq.description:
Description: I played nearly an identical version of this deck in the
storyline tournament at Anderson, IN. Major change from that deck was
I replaced Francois Villion with Anneke, with the idea of being able
to 2nd Tradition anywhere, she was too appealing to include in this

This deck is more along the "toolbox"-ish build than I usually prefer,
but it mainly relies on other Methuselahs thinking it is a dedicated
combat deck. For that reason alone I threw in a solitary Immortal
Grapple to assure people that I *might* have more in there.

Other than the Deflections, probably the game breaking card in the
deck is the Judgement: Camarilla Segregation. It never hit the table
during this tournament, but has proven in the past to be the
difference for me several times, especially when the table comes down
to 2 Methuselahs.

John Bell
Prince of Cincinnati
2k2ncrq.name: Bell's Bruise, Bleed, and Bloat Brujah

2k2watfordapr.author: Rob Treasure
2k2watfordapr.description:
A real abomination of a deck, constructed initially taking advantage
of Anneke's brilliant special to control the table but evolving into
something much nastier. Interestingly I only had to use her special
twice on the day and both of those times were in the final and saved
VP's from dropping to someone else (not an acceptable situation:o).
A evil VP sniper of a deck that puts the table under constant
pressure and drops atom bombs with alarming regularity. The sleazy
2nd trad / Obedience (hmmm I do like the picture on Sabbat
Obedience:o))) / Majesty combo allows you to stay untapped and
block loads of actions. In the second round I was under serious
pressure from Matt Stockton's weenie Pre deck and was pleased with the
constant ability to block 5/6/7 weenies a turn whilst laying down the
master phase bombs.
2k2watfordapr.name: The Turd

2k2amstelveen.author: Tim Eijpe
2k2amstelveen.description:
Description: A Smiling Jack deck with an equipment angle. Aus/aus
vampires and 5 vampires using Magic of the Smith to get Pier 13 and
the rest of the equipment. Survive and outlast. Use Eagle Sights to
keep people alive if neccessary. Build for the Amstelveen tourney
28/04/2002.
2k2amstelveen.name: Protect and Serve

2k2toronto.author: Andrew Weston
2k2toronto.description:
Not a fantastic deck by any means. This was the first time I had
played with it, though it was partly based on Bernie B's successful
Origins deck last year. Take out the Freak Drives, Extortions, Bleed
permanents for a better cycling deck I think...
2k2toronto.name: Unknown

2k2bangor0.author: Ben Peal
2k2bangor0.description:
Go-Go-Goratrix

Description: Rush combat/intercept combat hybrid, taking advantage of
Goratrix's built-in strike, and superior Animalism and Dominate.
Payload comes from Goratrix's +1 bleed, and some Governs (used
typically for bringing out more minions). Cheap supporting minions
provide heavy Auspex defense and extra bleeding, and the 5-caps help
with both defense and protecting Goratrix.

- Ben Peal, Prince of Boston
fudjo@mindstorm.com

and generate pool if you need it .

2k2rockville.name: "Mona Lisa Overdrive" (for the Smiling, and for the book.)

2k2tampere.author: Marko Saari
2k2tampere.description:
"Angus rules" (Gangrel bloat & voat)

This deck is based on Luis Duarte's Crusade Lisbon 2001 winning deck.
I just added more bloat, Stanislava (:-) and more combat & intercept
defense.
2k2tampere.name: Unknown

2k2castrovalley.author: Ian Lee
2k2castrovalley.description:
Winning Deck Name: Of Ghastly Dreams (best safety lies in fear)
Description: Clearly toolbox, the core is "intercept". This deck had
been doing well in our casual games, so with some tuning, I thought it
might be an interesting candidate for playing in a tournament. After
tuning, I goldfished a bit and realized just how many of the actions
are at zero stealth. The lack of stealth remains a problem. Should
pull Fleecing, an Overload, and probably the Patshivs.
Pseudo-Blindness was a metagame guess that didn't work particularly
well (in that I discarded all of them). The MVP was Mass Reality;
should be more than one.
2k2castrovalley.name: Unknown

2k2edmonton.author: Mattrim Dixon
2k2edmonton.description:
Rush'n'crush for offense; Rush'n'crush for defense. The name of this
deck comes from the fact that Pete Venters and L.A. Williams designed
the majority of the artwork contained herein. Oh, and I mustn't
forget the fact that this monster _is_ ('based' on) a work by

2k2edmonton.name: Oh Darling, Peter's Nosferatu LOVE L.A.!

2k2manilla.author: Nikos Quemuel
2k2manilla.description:
Central Comic Headquarters (CCHQ) was the site where 30 players
gathered to battle it out for High Stakes supremacy. After 3 grueling
rounds of preliminary bloodshed, 5 methuselahs came out on top:

1. Nikos (9VP, 3vp in final) - Gangrel Intercept
2. Kensai (9VP, 1vp in final) - Setite Politics

often doubled as a Rush action, and could always be cycled. I'm thinking

reverse alot, thus even with little or no votes(5 max) or combat you

2k2stranger.author: Kevin Scribner
2k2stranger.description:
"tzimisce - go: counterspell deck"

special thanks to jay kristoff, for his deck on thelasombra's site,
which was the inspiration for this one, and to david d'avila-anderson,
for his incredible articles on the subject of intercept-combat decks...
-- i've been playing this deck for over a year now, in various forms,
but it wasn't until bloodlines and 'read the winds' that i was able to
really get it off the ground... the raw power and efficiency of that
one card opened up so many card slots, which i was able to dedicate to
forward pressure, without compromising my ability to fend off 4-on-1
onslaughts turn after turn...
-- in light of the lessons i learned at this tournament, i think i'll
need to change the 2 anarch revolt to either 2 more smiling jack, or 2
war ghoul... the anarch revolts organize the table against me too much,
and turn my cross-table buddies into enemies... with smiling jack, they
at least think twice before coming at me... removing 2 revolts also
allows me to drop 2 of the eagle's sight, so maybe i'd go with 3 smiling
jack, 3 war ghoul, and exchange the femur of toomler for one more
revenant...
-- i'm seriously considering swapping out the duplicate caliban in the
crypt for either goratrix, matteus, omaya, or [most likely] jost
werner... the duplicate crypt draw doesn't really hurt me much, but
having jost's inherent stealth might make a big difference in some
games...
2k2stranger.name: Unknown

setscall2k1.author: Hans Nemeczek
setscall2k1.name: Laurent the wannabe-malk n his crew

christmas2k1.author: Martin Cubberley
christmas2k1.description:
Description: Get Suhailah to tool up with the Heart of Darkness then
Force of Will/Daring the Dawn your prey out of existence. Use the many
Minion Taps for pool gain and refill vamps with Fifth Traditions - which make
for a great pre-Force of Will action. The Second Traditions are there to
try and protect the Hearts, but it's not desperate if they go, just tool up
with another one.
christmas2k1.name: Suhailah Dares the Darkness

helsinki2k1.author: Heikki Poso
helsinki2k1.description:
Crypt worked well, I don't think I'd change anything. Corine was one of the mainstays, the +1 strength is really useful.

Masters were ok as well. Heidelburg was not as useful as I'd thought
it would be, but I rarely got it out before endgame. Pb: Montreal gave
me 15+ pool in final (played it on first turn, it was successfully
fetched only once by other players and I got it back immediately).

Meat Hooks were not as useful as I'd imagined; quite a bit of
IGs/maneuvers/S:CEs/dodges in the games. Perhaps replace one
with another Femur (never saw the one in time to equip with it)
and the other with Aid from Bats or something... Sixth intercept
retainer would be nice (in place of Crows), but I don't have it.

Quite nice, except that I once fed my only source of permanent
intercept to one and missed it quite a bit. Also opposing decks
unfairly did not stay still to be hit; some more Traps would
have been useful.

Discarded Malleable Visage all the times I drew it, so it might
be a candidate for replacement. Changelings were useful every
time I drew them.

Reactions worked well. No serious hand jams and even cross-table
vote decks did listen to my comments on acceptable voting
parameters.:-) Comment from prey: "Just _how_ much of that deck
is reaction cards?"

Middling to good. Inner Essences and BoA could perhaps be replaced
with something more useful; some presses would be nice. Got a less-than-
nice lesson on that by 1st round prey, who played a Tremere second
round combat deck...
helsinki2k1.name: Unknown

crusade_kosice2k1.author: Karol Magda
crusade_kosice2k1.description:
Description: Your aim is to get last 3VP on the table , agitate the
table to slow things down so you can build up your force , bring out
at least four minions and try to avoid pool loss. Be nice to your
predator and only block him , do not kill his vampires unless it's
necessary, doing so you can avoid his last spite when he will be dying.
Don't let your prey gain pool if it is possible and bleed for a lot.
Use eagle's sights only as an emergency intercept, otherwise
reserve it for cross table threats (or ousting bleed of your prey).
crusade_kosice2k1.name: Omaya

sanjuan2k1.author: Khervin Cheng Chua
sanjuan2k1.description:
Inspired by Derek Ray's Omaya Wall deck, this deck tools up a Country
!Gangrel with Auspex (ideally Omaya) with raven spies and wall up to protect
blood/pool-gainers while other vamps bleed or bounce bleeds...
sanjuan2k1.name: Oh My, Omaya!

cunctator2k1.author: Jay Kristoff
cunctator2k1.description:
I had seen on Lasombra's tournament winning decks page Johnny Tullner's
deck that won Fleecing the Gaje, held in Washington, D.C. I really like his
use of four Anarch Troublemaker. In Johnny's comments on the deck he wrote
"* Using an Anarch Troublemaker and then playing one is an excellent
tactic." Yes Johnny, it is. I decided to try to make room for my four
A.T.s. I was only able to fit three in, and in doing so I ended up with too
many master cards in the deck. Well, I wouldn't be writing this if I
didn't win, so I guess it couldn't have been that bad.

Frederick is NOT Weak!
cunctator2k1.name: Unknown

crusade_atlanta_2k1.author: David Anderson-Dávila
crusade_atlanta_2k1.description:
Description: Bleed with Seduction, Call of the Hungry Dead and the
occasional Sleeping Mind. This combo should shut down even the most
dedicated intercept decks. Use Obedience and Spiritual Intervention
for combat defense. Use liberal bleed bounce to enhance the defence.
crusade_atlanta_2k1.name: Giovanni Power Bleed

hammond2k1.author: David Hammond
hammond2k1.description:
Description: Long range cel / pot workout with Thoughts Betrayed
stopping any nastiness...

Sucks against damage prevention, and dies vs Drawing out the Beast. It
also has limited blood gen - but once you have 2 vampires up, you are
usually safe. Other than that, it has great card flow, superb handling
and really does the business. Not a great deck, or original, but my
best effort in the last few months.

Notes:

1) Trioles Revenge is in there just because I have been against a lot
of Ventrue decks lately. I did have Graverobbing in there, which I
will probably revert to at some stage.

2) The 44s are key permenants in the endame - as borne out earlier.

3) NO HUNTING GROUND! You don't need it - steal the ineveitable Rack.
Interesting that I hunted only once with one vampire all day!

4) Best card for flow... ever - Infernal Pursuit (sup)! Can be played
any time in combat and really clears a hand jam.

5) Only 2 rares in the deck! You don't need a horde of pricey rares to
win.
hammond2k1.name: The Eurobrujah know what you did last summer...

crusadelisbon2k1.author: Luis Duarte
crusadelisbon2k1.description:
Type: Vote/Bloat

The deck strength resides on the vampires titles. The big ones can be
brought faster boosted by Ingrid's ability, Dreams of the Sphinx, Powerbase:Montreal and
especially Zillah's Valley. Ramona's ability is very useful especially if she runs out of
blood after playing some Protean action modifiers.

- Zillah's Valley is very useful to control faster big vampires and in the mid-game it makes a great combo with Parity Shift. ;)
- Creepshow Casino is very useful to political actions, to hunt, ...
- Powerbase:Montreal is a good way to place an additional blood on an uncontrolled vampire with nmo cost. The Second Traditions never get jammed on hand for long periods... and it can be combined with Ecoterrorists for a blood cow!
- Elysium:Palace of Versailles helps adding some votes.
- Visit From The Capuchin is very very good, and it has a similar effect as Dreams of the Sphynx on card advantage.
- Fifth Traditions are a great blood source combined with Minion Tap for bloat.
- Judgement:Camarilla Segregation are useful and most of the times other players burn vampires in torpor.
- Masochisms help paying some cards costs like Earth Control and Rapid Change. It can be combined with Flesh of Marble.
- Ablative Skin is a add-on, just in case, to prevent some extra damage.
- Rapid Change sometimes is useful to end combat.
- Closed Session helps against the Lasombra and other Sabbat votes against.
- Parity Shifts help control the table. Can be combined with Zillah's Valley to meet the pool requirements during the turn it is played.
- Banishments are easy to play on most vampires since the titled Gangrels are high capacity.
- Corruption's Purge are playable on all Setite at once, burning 2 blood and sending them to torpor if they don't have 2 blood to burn. Useful it your predator has plenty of Followers of Set.
- Protect Thine Own helps burning some weenie non-Camarilla vampires.
- Flesh of Marble almost kill Potence decks, and if the damage is aggravated it can be combined with Skin of Night. The single point of damage "feeds" the Masochism.
- Second Tradition are a good example how a card justifies the use of bigger titled Camarilla vampires. Wake, untap, with +2 intercept is very good on a single card. Without this card, this deck almost got no real effective defense without changing other cards and its proportions.
crusadelisbon2k1.name: Gangrel say goodbye to the Camarilla!

purity2k10.author: Kevin J. Mergen
purity2k10.description:
Description: Fairly standard Tzimischeese intercept deck with long-term goals in
mind. Jack's War Ghoul protection service is your key to victory.
Props to Jay Kristoff for helping me master the Tzimisce

In retrospect, I think I would change this crypt by removing the 2 Dragos for 2
more Little Tailor. Even when I saw Dragos, I never *wanted* to bring him out,
and Little Tailor bringing out Tatu for a total of 2 pool (a free Revenant and a
2-pool Tatu) is simply ridiculous. (Another variant would be 4 Little Tailor, 4
Meshenka, 4 Sascha, although I don't know how this would work. I'm sure it
would be fine.)

Note that if you're going to play AoR in a deck like this, you must have 3 (or
more in a larger deck) as you will probably be forced to let it be removed
eventually, but you want to have one around constantly as it and Jack are your
primary sources of damage.

I would probably take out 2 Eagle's Sight for an extra Cat's and an extra FA,
since they are so critical to the deck. The power of Big Eye is simply amazing.

After I played the first BotD, people kept asking me *every combat* if I had
another BotD. I always told them "Yes, but it doesn't need to be played right
now" and just smiled. When this deck was larger, it had more BotD, but when I
decided the Atlanta deck-building philosophy was the correct and true path, I
had to cut SOMETHING to get to 75, and 6 BotD went bye-bye. You really only
need these for decks like Dave's S&B, who rely on getting away via maneuvers, so
you don't need more than a couple.

I used to think Nephandus or the Renegade Garou was the best ally. I was
mistaken. Tatu wins games.

As you can see, the deck really does only one thing -- get out Smiling Jack, and
protect him until it doesn't matter any more. This is about the 4th version of
this deck I have made, and the first one to almost entirely abandon pool gain.
Several people have made what I call the "pool gain" version of this deck, as
did James Hamblin and I last year after Sabbat War came out. The Gangrel are
also easily played with a deck of this type. Jay Kristoff won an Ohio
tournament with his version (http://www.vekn.fr/decks/twd.htm#jaykic),
which is more or less a master-heavy "pool gain" version.
purity2k10.name: Jack's War Ghoul Protection Service

octoberla2k1.author: Dennis Lien
octoberla2k1.description:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/llQH7j4T23M/-1XPyZp13K4J

Scourge of El Segundo

"The Waiting"

This is the first time I've ever run this deck or anything like it. I
attempted to build a deck that could survive long enough in a tournament
environment in order to make a deal or two and then finish off my prey
and maybe my grand prey in one huge flurry. Based on my
previous tournament experience I figured I'd face alot of bleed and vote
and not much rush/combat that didn't feature IG (in which case
I'd be screwed anyway), hence the lack of combat cards. The idea is to
generate enough blood to keep your pool away from any huge
votes or bleeds, Sudden or DI anything that's gonna hurt you real bad,
try not to piss off the D-attackers, let your predator bleed your
prey and wait for the moment to strike.

The crypt features 7 votes and plenty of Dominate for those
Deflections. Plus with 42 master cards out of 90 total, Anson is a MUST.
Ulugh and Cardano are the Day Op finishers and Muaziz is versatility.
You must be VERY patient playing this deck, you can't really go
forward until you're ready to commit everything for the kill. I tried
to rifle through the deck as quickly as possible (Storage
Annex/Ulugh/Parthenon) and get the cards I need for the finisher locked
in the annexes. All you're looking for is to get your prey down
to 7 pool, then send Muaziz in to knock out any stoppers with a
Revelations and then go for it! Ultimately this is proof that a deck
doesn't have to be some kind of "nasty creature" to win a tourney.
octoberla2k1.name: Unknown

fleece2k10.author: Johnny Tullner
fleece2k10.description:
At long last, the deck that won at Fleecing the Gaje,
held in Washington, D.C. on October 20, 2001,
presented in its entirety and with comments from the
winning player, Mr. Johnny Tullner of Hampton, VA:

Weenies That Bleed





(22)



* I spent long hours tuning this deck to mathematical perfection.
* Using an Anarch Troublemaker and then playing one is an excellent tactic.
* Hand jam is the biggest problem, but usually the only thing to discard is
locations you already have out.
* Tribute to the Master is almost never used. It's there for emergencies.
* There are 4 rares, 21 uncommons, and 56 commons. I love the balance of
Jyhad that does not rely on rarity.
* The deck will usually sweep. Expect the whole table to come after you.
* My friends don't let me play this against them, and I don't blame them.

elsegundo2k1.author: Dennis Lien
elsegundo2k1.description:
Scourge of El Segundo
"A" vote deck

This is a modification of my earlier deck that featured Anson and Rake with
Natasha. I figured too many people would use Anson in a tournament setting,
so I switched. Actually, Arika is simply better for my purposes.
The idea is rather simple, limit the blood supply, then wait until you can
kill your prey with a couple of stealthy votes and whack the rest of the
table at the same time. This is principally a weenie stomper.
There is precious little defense, save the Redirections and Obedience. I
figured if I was facing rush combat then IG would wipe out my Majesties
anyway. I was right! But in hindsight I do regret not including some
Rolling with the Punches. Not a single intercept card and I don't think
that's a problem. Unless you're stealthily D-attacking me, I don't care what
you do, just bring out more minions please.
Big time blood recursion with the Taps and Caps.
The main problem with getting the votes off is cancellation and Delaying
Tactics. Shrug. Three "finisher" cards with the Day Ops and the Air.

Tournament Notes
Robert Acevedo was my bane all day. He was playing
Ventrue Ante with Quinton AND Demonstration. Ugh!

Game #1, Robert was my prey and he got his combo out
quick, shutting down my votes. Marcos was my predator with a Beast/Rush
deck. He killed Arika the turn after I brought her out and that was about
that. I held on to outlive Marcos; moral victory. Robert swept.

Game #2 and now Robert is my predator and Marcos is
my prey. Sigh! Here we go again. Luckily I made a deal with Marcos that I
wouldn't bleed him if he didn't attack me. (Not bleeding your prey? Talk
about suicide!) I figured I'd have my hands full with Robert's bleeds anyway.
Fortunately Larry's weenie bleeder took Robert out with a stealthy 7
bleed, Go Peter Blaine! That got Quinton off of my back and the next turn I
called an Ancilla and Banished the Beast. Marcos attacked me, breaking
our deal, so I deflected Larry's next big bleed and then bled out Marcos.
Two Ancillas later, Larry's weenies had betrayed him and what was left of his
pool.

Final: I was seeded 4th and Julien chose me as his
prey. I don't know if he knew what my deck did, but he was playing Dramatic
Upheaval, so it didn't matter much anyway. I think he mostly chose to have
Cary for his predator because he was the only non-bleeder at the table.
Larry ousted Cary very quickly and I was at Robert's mercy even though he was
my prey, because that accursed Quinton was out again. Larry made a deal to
back off of Julien until Robert and I were dead. Oops. Robert and I then
conspired to vote Larry out and I figured I'd get second if Robert could
bleed out Julien and then roll for me. Surprise, surprise. Julien was not
only resilient, he outgained Robert and Hostiled Quinton. Robert was getting
low on pool, so he had to let him go. I hadn't gone below 15 that game so I
jumped in and bid 8 for Quinton. That kinda cinched it. Robert couldn't
kill Julien with only two minions so I agreed to let Julien withdraw if he
backed off me until I killed Robert. (I HATE when these deals switch
around!) Anyway, Robert got down to 3 pool with one minion and I had to
resort to calling three Anarchist Uprisings to kill him so he couldn't
deflect a bleed. Julien withdrew and took second, Robert took third. When
was the last time someone won a final as the only guy with 2VP? Weird
tourney, where were the Malks?

grandrapids2k1.author: Aaron Steele
grandrapids2k1.description:
or 'Yes I can block every action'

Play anarch revolt. Block all actions that damage anyone, you want to
make sure that the anarch's do their damage in order so everyone is
ousted in sequence. Always bring out Anneke for her built in eagle
sight, then 2nd Tradition/Obedience everyone. Also 1st Tradition so
people have to pay even more to take a turn..you don't need them just
block. Minion tap/5th Tradition for pool gain.

Deck idea came from my first round at the nationals where Bernie B.
was playing his ultra sucky "All 6 traditions" deck. The 1st
tradition he played combined with someone elses anarch revolt killed
everyone on the table. Usually makes for a fast game, you kill or die
quickly.

minicon2k1.author: Matt Green
minicon2k1.description:
Deck: Rough Night at the Palla Grande

Playing the deck: Never discard any of the 12 kill cards. Counter
Blood gain with the Suddens. Use Revelations to remove Deflections or
blood gain from your prey's hand as the first action per turn if
possible. Depending on the deck use a Revelations about 1 in 3 turns.
Get someone with superior Obfuscate quite quickly to cloak actions.
Remember that, largely, you suck at combat. Kill Mr. Winthrop or
Spys/Revenants at range if possible.

Could probably do with a Bomb instead of a Patronage, if I was to play
it again.

cheers
mattgreen.

genconuk2k1-treasure.author: Rob Treasure
genconuk2k1-treasure.description:
It's a reworked version of the old classic, built to handle most
threats but a field of pure focus would not be the best. Other than
my various Ventrue creations and the retired LoP. deck it is probably
the one that I have spent most time over the years tweaking and analysing.
Interestingly it is also the deck that I have scored the least VP's (1)
with in a tourney with ? Metagames hey !!

It tackles most common ‘tourney standard' decks very well and slugs it
out with all but pure Gangrel Potence and Tzimisce Scorpion Sting/Blood
of Acid. Got to be wary of Kiss of Ra and Hostile Takeover, they are
really the only two things that really worry it consistently.

I did have another Sudden Reversal and 2 Leathers in up to a few minutes
before the tourney but traded them out for the Guardian Angel,
another Disarm and a 7th Second Tradition.

The Guardian Angel was amazingly useful and came out in most of the rounds,
the 7th Second was exactly the right amount on the day. Very happy with the
decks performance, it had enough whack to take out Beast and friends in a
pure combat deck and was ‘focussed' enough to apply consistent pressure on
my prey all the time.

genconuk2k1-treasure.name: EuroBrujah 2001

gateway2k1-robert.author: Robert Goudie
gateway2k1-robert.description:
Description: The deck was created rather quickly to take advantage of the
"multiple action modifiers of the same type" loophole found in Mask 1k. The
idea was to use Mask 1k to be able to play multiple Command of the Beast on the
same action. Also, Mask is easy enough to cycle if they decide not to block me
so I can cycle readily.

I think the concept is strong but the execution really isn't good at all. The
deck was never playtested and wasn't finished until a few minutes before the
event started. It is missing Master Cards and has too few Govern bleeds and a
number of other things I'd tweak. The deck also jams massively on stealth. In
the prelims I had Anarch decks at my tables and the 4 cap vampires and some
quick bleeds helped me oust my preys. In the finals, I was fortunate enough to
have the end-game come down to Jason Dawson and myself. Jason was playing a
heavy heavy Auspex intercept deck. Jason's hearty block attempts at 4-6
intercept were just what my over-stealthed deck needed to cycle for the bleed
cards. It was fate.
gateway2k1-robert.name: Whole Lotta Faces

gateway2k1-brad.author: Brad Ward
gateway2k1-brad.description:
The prelims were pretty nasty. I abused the crap out of the Succubus
Club. The first table I ended up using it to save myself from dying 3
different times. After paying my predator 1 pool to "borrow" her
rats, I had the set up to oust Steve Bucy with a Perfect
Clarity/Daring Dawn bleed. This burned Spiro and left me with no
minions. I worked a deal with Nat Hammond to help oust my predator.
The Succubus Club came in really handy letting me offer Nat and myself
unlimited card cycling using Succubus to trade the Elder Library back
and forth.

I don't remember much from the second round, except that Succubus came
in abusively helpful once again by being able to constantly trade
Milicent Smith back to myself at the begining of every turn. This
time Nat Hammond got to be on the recieving end of that horrible
succubus club card.

The Final had the following seating order:

#1 Brad Ward - Spiridonas Soul Gem/Perfect Clarity/Daring Dawn
#2 John Amato - Black Cat, Celerity Equipment !Brujah/Brujah
#3 Paul Johnson - ???
#4 Jason Dawson - Anarch Revolt Weenie Dominate/Bleed/Bleed Bouncer
#5 ??? -

Attention first went to Jason who had the Anarch heavy bleed
Deflection deck. Paul and Jason's prey (don't recall who)
really tried to put the hurt on Jason. I was the only one with votes
on the table. Jason, seeing his demise offered to help me however he
could if I would vote to keep his Anarchs in play while he ousts his
prey. My prey (John) was putty in my hands, having neither bleed
bounce, intercept nor stealth. Jason's prey fell first followed
by Paul Johnson. I then ousted John Amato and Jason followed through
with his deal and rolled over. The game was over in about an hour or
less thanks to the Anarch Revolts.

Note: The deck is only less than 90 cards because I had limited
number of Perfect Clarity. I plan to increase it to 90 as I acquire
more.
gateway2k1-brad.name: Unknown

dragoncon2k1-david.author: David Tatu
dragoncon2k1-david.description:
Description: I built this deck the morning of the tournament because
I had not seen any Ventrue decks the night before and I wanted to play
one. I think that the Ventrue are (just by a small margin) the strongest
clan in the game but I hate to contest Vampires all day so I avoid
playing them too much. The deck is pretty basic. I do not normally
use Queen Anne unless I am working the Dominate angle. I also really
wanted to use Kiss of Ra and Seduction to screw with the intercept
decks. It really worked. I got to Kiss Meshenka with a Revenant and
then Seduce Dragos when I grave robbed. I also got to grave rob Ulugh
Beg and an one-armed Basil (It was a card cycle thing). I had Jan out
in two games, which I think screwed with a lot of people's minds. He
was also able to bleed for 2 most every turn due to my prey being scared
of his Kiss of Ra. The deck got 4, 2.5 and 4 (a sweep) VPs and then 2.5VP
in the Finals. I never got near the end of my library so I would cut out
15 cards (Deflect, Con Ag, Club Z, Closed Session, Bonding, B.O. WwEF,
2 x Voter Cap, SoS, Majesty, Obedience, Govern and Freak Drive) and I
would swap the Queen for a second Emerson. A valuable lesson I learned
playing in this tourney is that Emerson can tell that mad rusher, Theo
Bell, to have a seat and try again next turn. There was a Theo deck at
two of the table I played at. This deck is not that strong in offence so
I had to play careful and do a lot of table talking. The only deals I made
regarding VPs took place in the finals and I only had to follow through on
one of them. The other one was a "I will let you oust him if you then roll
over" deal but my prey was unable to complete his end of the deal so he
had to go and I had to do the oust myself.
dragoncon2k1-david.name: Dragon Con 2001 Ventrue

gencon2k1-thursday.author: Scott Christofersen
gencon2k1-thursday.description:
Description: Stealth Bleed

Keep it simple. Get out a bleeder as quick as you can and keep bleeding.
If you bring out a vampire and you are bleed, bounce the bleed.
If you get bounced and you are going to take out someone elses prey play
Spying Mission. Suddens are for minion taps or very bad for you masters.
Pranks are to keep other prey in the game by giving them pool or to slow the
game/gain pool on early turns. Fear of mekhet was tossed in moments before I
left for gencon as I thought there might be some big bad bloat decks.

well... that was the idea... things went sour when Robyn put out a war ghoul
turn 3 in the first round and I had to gain pool like mad for many turns as
I made the deal not to bleed her if she just didn't come my way with the war
ghoul over and over. Govern back and suck it off/prank saved me from the 4+
bleed a turn I was taking till I thought I might be able to take her out in
one turn and didn't make the deal. I think I got my max stealth action of 7
to get the bleed in and I actually felt bad about it. Robyn should have won
that game in my opinion if she had wanted to pound on the poor guy who had
only played 2 games in his life that was her prey.

The final was pure seating as Jeff (the Lasombra) knows. All in all luck
won the day for me more than anything. Took 19VP thursday and 0 friday
mostly due to bad play by me and a bit of bad luck as well.
gencon2k1-thursday.name: All ahead full...

watford-ts.author: Tony Smith
watford-ts.description:
Deck: Notaweeniedominatedeck version III

The idea is to hit the ground running. Either use
superior Govern to pull out your vamps for 1 pool, and
assault once a huge force is amassed. Or bleed like
shit off a shovel from the first turn. Either way it
often takes out multiply preys in a turn. If it's
running well, and your prey has no Deflections, it
should clean then out in about 4 turns.
Little combat defense but letting a few die to get
through with the one 6 point bleed is often the way to
go
Cheesy as hell, but funny as fuck.

Ivory Bow (didn't see it all day, may need to come
out)

The 2 vamps in the crypt with superior Dominate were a
last minute thing. They can't use the Governs at
superior, but the inclusion allowed me to cut the
number of dom masters and makes it run a little
quicker if they are in the opening crypt. I found that
by using 4 caps as opposed to the normal dom weenies,
I got all the benefits of a weenie deck, but with a
few less disadvantages.

dallascc.author: Ethan Burrow
dallascc.description:
This is *my* Toolbox
by Ethan Burrow

The idea was to vote/bloat with Voter Captivations acting as 5th Traditions,
since the Sabbat can't obviously play 5th Tradition. Most other cards in the
deck were either single shot utilitarian or very versatile in keeping with my
current trend of toolboxing. You may note that a lot of the cards have
multiple uses.

Enchant Kindred can serve 3 purposes; speed up influencing, bleed, or pool
gain. All the intercept cards doubled as bleed bounce, so I could defend
against many deck types.

I also wanted to include enough combat defense that I might be able to survive
a rush deck long enough to grab 1VP.

The fact that there are only 12 masters was purely coincidental, and had
nothing to do with Atlanta <g>.

edmonton2k1.author: Mattrim Dixon
edmonton2k1.description:
https://groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/0sk7pwVY57Y



The idea behind the deck is simple:
keep yourself alive, almost indefinitely, by bloating like crazy
from the Blood Dolls / Hungry Coyote combination, supplemented by
Govern the Unaligned and Scouting Mission at superior. After you
have a suitable number of minions up and your prey is low enough
in pool (less than twelve, heh), steamroll your prey with stealthed
up nicely: "And here we must observe that men must either be
flattered or crushed; for they will revenge themselves for slight
wrongs; whilst for grave ones they cannot. The injury, therefore,
that you do a man should be such that you need not fear for revenge."

The weak spots of this deck, as with most focused decks, are numerous.
The lack of intercept, with the exception of Angelica, is a major sore
spot, which actually cost me two victory points in the final. Should
anyone seek to replicate this deck, I suggest substituting a number
of intercept cards in for the Redirections. A heavy-duty rush-combat
deck with Immortal Grapple would tear this deck to shreds, as the
maneuvers are light. Depending on your local metagame, replacement
of a number of Shadow Step for Arms of the Abyss may be in order.
The addition of a Power Structure, to defend against vote-based decks,
would also benefit the deck greatly as it will often finish the game
with four-plus minions.

mannheim2k1.description:

made some mistake with the renting of the room, so we had to leave too early

thread for a round or two, but then the game went my way and my deck swept
that table, too.

Carpe Jugulum.

Christoph

darbyla2k1.author: Darby Keeney
darbyla2k1.description:
Description: Concept and playstyle are simple, BLEEEEED!

Process: Try to influence 3-4 vampires out in the
same turn, unless you're being no-stealth bleed for
a bunch early. Pentex that big vampire your prey
first influences after you've got your critters in a
line. Attempt to bleed with enhancement. Use S:CE to
tap out any Wakey blockers. Repeat process lots of times,
using Propaganda & Anarch Troublemaker only when you think
you can bleed your prey out.

Hint: If you don't have S:CE in hand, consider bleeding
anyway. Use Media Influence (sup) to refill anyone in torpor
(it works on all controlled vampires), then rescue them and
begin bleeding again. If you have too much S:CE, bleed anyway
and hope for combat to clear your hand.

Pool management is mostly from rapid ousting and can
cause high stomach acid levels. Social Charm (sup), Enchant
Kindred (sup) and Tribute to the Master followed by Media
Influence (sup) can supplement when Tums(r) are insufficient.
Deck is weakest against vote, steath bleed and weenie bleed decks.

Possible offensive improvements/variants, depending
on metagame:
Pump bleed by using 4-8 Legal Manipulation replacing
Social Charm and/or Tribute to the Master.
Get slightly more deceitful - and nominally faster,
by adding 1-4 more Aire of Elation, in place of Enchant Kindred.
Add more tap effects with 1-2 Propaganda in place of Enchant Kindred or

Possible defensive improvements/variants, depending on metagame:
Substitute 1-2 Archon Investigation for Tribute to the Master.
Consider 1-4 Delaying Tactics in place of Social Charm and/or Enchant Kindred.

la3.author: Robert Goudie
la3.description:
Robert Goudie's Weenie Obfuscate/Auspex deck

Well, first of all, I'm suprised at the contents now that I look at
it. The original version was more heavily weighted toward Night Moves.
This is probably half as many as were in the first version. I also
removed all of the dodges and instead put more intercept. I've always
called it a night moves deck but that really doesn't describe it well
anymore. Let's call it a Weenie Obfuscate/Auspex deck.

The crypt design is pretty obvious. I put 2 of each vampire that had
Auspex+Obfuscate. I also put 2 of the 1 or 2 capacity vamps with
Obfuscate. The Auspex vamps are key. I need to get at least one to
start with.

I think I'm pretty well known for really focussed decks (weenie dom bleed,
weenie cryptic mission, weenie undead persistance, etc.) and this is
somewhat of a departure. They're still weenies but I put in a good
number of cards that may or may not be useful. As it turned out, these
additions that watered-down my stealth bleed were a big benefit to me.

I believe I won with no library cards left so I had an opportunity to
play all of the one-shot cards. Delaying Tactics was used to save my bacon.
The Malkavian Dementias were quite nasty and allowed me to take Lucian
from my predator at a couple of key moments. The Muddled was quite useful,
as were the Haven Uncovered (I believe Paul made use of it to attack
Jeff) and the Sudden Reversals.

I essentially used my size to get a quick kill of my first prey. Then,
I had enough intercept to keep my next prey and my predator from killing
me. The neverending supply of stealthy bleeds eventually did the trick.

-Robert
